exercises.name: squat
coaching_cues: Push your hips back as if sitting into a chair
Keep your knees tracking over your toes
safety_warnings: Stop if you feel sharp pain in any joint
Hold onto a chair or counter for balance if needed

exercises.name: push_up
coaching_cues: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Keep a straight line from head to heels
Lower slowly and press back up with control
safety_warnings: Stop if you feel sharp pain in the shoulder, elbow, or wrist
Drop to your knees if you cannot keep your body straight

warmup: March in place for 2 minutes, then do 10 arm circles in each direction and 10 leg swings per side.
cooldown: Walk slowly for 1 minute, then hold a quadriceps stretch and a chest stretch for 30 seconds each.
overall_safety: This is a light full-body plan. Keep every rep slow and controlled. Stop and consult your physical therapist if pain increases during or after the session.
